comparison.objective: Hold an LED flush while applying a soldering iron, not configure a gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain component seating while precisely contacting a pad with another tool.
comparison.success_condition: LED stays flush during two seconds of pad contact and the iron returns tip-first to its stand.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is shared generically, but solder tacking has no adjusted value or locking reaction.
